title: Settings

capturePolicy.title: Capture policy
capturePolicy.desc: Whether {{members}} can change capture settings on their own device.

screenshotInterval.title: Screenshot interval
screenshotInterval.desc: How often each {{member}}'s screen is captured.

idleThreshold.title: Idle threshold
idleThreshold.desc: No input for this long pauses active-time counting.

screenshotMode.title: Screenshot mode
screenshotMode.privacyDesc: Only the active window is captured — never the whole screen. No screenshot is taken while apps on the skip list are in front (prefilled with well-known chat, password and banking apps).
screenshotMode.normalDesc: Every screen is captured in full.

skipApps.title: Skip apps
skipApps.desc: No screenshot is taken while any of these apps is in front. Matching is forgiving: "Zalo" also covers "Zalo PC".

retention.title: Screenshot retention
retention.desc: How long the backend keeps uploaded screenshots for {{name}}. "Never" keeps them indefinitely.
retention.activityDesc: Keep active/idle and application activity for this many days.
retention.screenshotsDesc: Keep uploaded screenshots for this many days. “Never” keeps them indefinitely.
retention.browserDesc: Keep managed browser activity for this many days.
retention.keystrokesDesc: Keep aggregate keystroke counts for this many days.
retention.previewFailed: Could not preview the retention change.
retention.previewRows: A {{days}}-day policy makes {{count}} existing records eligible for deletion.
retention.previewScreenshots: A {{days}}-day policy makes {{count}} screenshots ({{size}}) eligible for deletion.
retention.workerNotice: Saving the shorter period does not delete data in this dialog. The retention worker removes eligible data according to the new policy.

cleanup.title: Manual cleanup
cleanup.desc: Permanently remove selected organization data by age or calendar range.
cleanup.warning: Selected records older than {{days}} days are permanently removed. This cannot be undone.
cleanup.warningRange: Selected records from {{from}} through {{to}} are permanently removed. This cannot be undone.
cleanup.selectClass: Select at least one data class.
cleanup.rangeTimezone: Calendar days are interpreted in the organization timezone: {{timezone}}.

audit.title: Administrative actions
audit.desc: Recent account and device changes for this organization. Passwords, tokens and screenshot contents are never stored here.
audit.loadFailed: Could not load the audit log.
audit.empty: No administrative actions have been recorded yet.

v1.emptyDescription: Administrative changes will appear here as they happen.

audit.noMatchesDescription: Try changing the search query or filters.

roleDenied: Your role can view reports, but organization settings require owner or admin access.

v1.subtitle: Organization preferences for {{name}}
v1.noBusinessDescription: Create or select an organization before configuring monitoring.

organization.description: Organization identity and your access level.
organization.name: Organization name

monitoring.description: Control how workstation activity and idle time are managed.

screenshots.description: Configure screenshot capture frequency and privacy exclusions.

storage.description: Retention and manual cleanup of uploaded screenshot data.

devices.description: Control enrollment-code lifetime and how many active devices each member may use.

organization.nameHelp: Shown in the organization switcher, reports and audit context.
organization.typeHelp: Controls product terminology. Existing data and monitoring policy are preserved.
organization.ownerOnly: Only the organization owner can change the type.
organization.timezoneHelp: Defines day boundaries for Today/Yesterday and reports. Stored timestamps are never rewritten.
organization.weekStartHelp: Auto follows the interface locale; choose a day to override it.
organization.typeSafeIntro: ActiLens will change this organization to {{type}}.
organization.noDataLoss: Activity, screenshots, browser history, keystroke counts or audit history.
organization.noMemberChanges: Member accounts, roles, passwords, monitoring states or devices.
organization.noPolicyReset: Retention, capture policy, privacy rules or enrollment settings.

monitoring.activeIdleHelp: Core managed monitoring signal. It cannot be disabled independently.
monitoring.defaultMemberHelp: Default state applied when a new member is created. Existing members are never changed silently.
monitoring.appActivityHelp: Collect application names and active time. Turning this off also disables window-title collection.
monitoring.windowTitlesHelp: Collect active window titles. When disabled, clients do not transmit titles to the server.
monitoring.browserHelp: Collect active-tab URL/title/time from the managed browser extension and desktop agent.
monitoring.keystrokesHelp: Collect counts only. Typed content is never captured.
monitoring.defaultDialogBody: The new default will be {{state}}. {{count}} existing active memberships currently differ.
monitoring.defaultSaved: Default monitoring state updated for future members.
monitoring.defaultApplied_one: Default updated and applied to {{count}} existing member.
monitoring.defaultApplied_other: Default updated and applied to {{count}} existing members.

screenshots.enabledHelp: Stops future capture when disabled. Interval, scope and privacy rules are preserved for re-enable.
screenshots.scopeHelp: Choose exactly what is captured when screenshots are enabled.

activeWindow.label: Active window only
activeWindow.description: Capture only the active application window.

activeDisplay.label: Active display
activeDisplay.description: Capture the display containing the active window.

allDisplays.label: All displays
allDisplays.description: Capture every connected display as separate images in one capture group.

screenshots.intervalHelp: How often the managed agent may capture screenshots while active.
screenshots.privacyHelp: Prevent capture before an image is created when an application or window-title rule matches.

devices.limitHelp: Only non-revoked devices in this organization count. Leave empty for unlimited. Revoking a device frees one organization slot immediately.
devices.limitInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1000, or leave it empty for unlimited.
devices.enrollmentTTLHelp: Default lifetime for newly generated one-time enrollment codes.
devices.enrollmentBehaviorHelp: A valid one-time enrollment code accepts a new device automatically while the organization-wide active-device limit has capacity.

accountSecurity.title: Account & security
accountSecurity.subtitle: Manage your sign-in identity, password, sessions and two-factor authentication.
accountSecurity.loadFailed: Could not load account security settings.
accountSecurity.saveFailed: Could not save the account change.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Basic account identity shown in ActiLens.

identity.title: Login identifiers
identity.description: Email and username can both be used to sign in when configured.
identity.logoutWarning: Changing your email or username revokes all existing sessions. You will need to sign in again.
identity.failed: Could not change the login identifiers. Check your password and ensure the email/username are available.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing your password invalidates every current session.
password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
password.failed: Could not change the password. Check your current password and try again.
password.logoutWarning: After the password is changed, all sessions including this one are revoked.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: See where your account is signed in and revoke access you no longer recognize.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: Protect sign-in with a TOTP authenticator and one-time recovery codes.
mfa.enabledHelp: A TOTP or unused recovery code is required after the password.
mfa.disabledHelp: Only your password is currently required.
mfa.manualIntro: Add this secret to a TOTP authenticator app, then enter the current 6-digit code.
mfa.regenerateWarning: Generating new recovery codes permanently invalidates every previous recovery code.
mfa.disableWarning: Disabling two-factor authentication reduces account security and revokes all current sessions.
mfa.recoveryWarning: These 10 recovery codes are shown only once. Store them somewhere secure. Each code can be used one time.

privacyRules.title: Screenshot privacy rules
privacyRules.preventCapture: Rules are checked before capture. When a rule matches the active app or window title, ActiLens does not create a screenshot.
privacyRules.saveFailed: Could not save the privacy rule.
privacyRules.deleteFailed: Could not delete the privacy rule.
privacyRules.emptyDescription: Add rules for applications or window titles that must never be captured.
privacyRules.suggestionsHelp: Add a preset as an exact application-name rule. You can edit it afterwards.
privacyRules.windowTitlesHelp: Optional: skip a screenshot when the active window title contains the specified text.

exports.title: Exports
exports.description: Generate downloadable organization data in the background. Ready files expire after 7 days.
exports.failed: Export generation failed. You can request a new export.

lifecycle.activeHelp: Monitoring, enrollment and organization changes are available.
lifecycle.archivedHelp: The organization is read-only. Sync, enrollment and policy changes are stopped until it is restored.
lifecycle.deletionPendingHelp: Permanent deletion is scheduled for {{value}}. The organization stays archived until then.
lifecycle.archiveWarning: Archiving immediately stops managed sync and new enrollment. Historical reports, audit and exports remain available, and the organization can be restored.
lifecycle.transferHelp: Transfer ownership to an active administrator. The current owner becomes an administrator.
lifecycle.transferWarning: Both the current and new owner will be signed out after the transfer.
lifecycle.noAdmins: There is no active administrator eligible to become owner.
lifecycle.mfaOptional: Authenticator or recovery code (required when 2FA is enabled)
lifecycle.mfaRequired: Enter a valid authenticator or recovery code.
lifecycle.transferFailed: Could not transfer ownership. Verify your password, MFA code and selected administrator.
lifecycle.deleteHelp: After scheduling, there is a 7-day cancellation window. The organization remains archived and read-only.
lifecycle.deleteWarning: After 7 days the organization, organization-scoped monitoring data and accounts with no other memberships are permanently deleted.
lifecycle.previewFailed: Could not calculate the deletion preview.
lifecycle.backupHelp: A full export is recommended but not required. It is generated in the background and appears under Data storage.
lifecycle.scheduleFailed: Could not schedule deletion. Verify your password and MFA code.
lifecycle.deletionCancelled: Scheduled deletion cancelled. The organization remains archived.
